The dragon is a long serpentine mass of BLACK FIRE with a readable head, open jaws and violet rim flames, not an animal made of scales or a solid purple object. Zeru is now physically absent and never reappears. Hiei lowers the exhausted RIGHT arm slightly and glances down at the hand with contained pain; the last violet flames extinguish around it. His already torn clothing stays torn; do not restore fabric, grow a coat or change trousers. No fresh graphic wound.
